description: What x402 API should I build? The demand gap finder runs up to 150 Bazaar searches phrased the way buyer agents phrase tasks and ranks the unmet demand: tasks whose top results are weak (no listings, few payers, thin descriptions or a poor fit), with the evidence for each. Public Bazaar data only, joined with measured repeat demand per category. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Failed calls aren't charged.
